name: Wall Blades Trap
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to disengage the mechanisms that operate the blades in one wall
reset: The trap deactivates when the room is empty and resets after 1 minute.
routine: (3 actions) For each wall in which the mechanisms have been disabled or destroyed, the hazard has 1 fewer action. On each action, the hazard makes a serrated blade Strike against one creature within 10 feet of the west, east, or south wall. Each set of wall blades acts once per turn.

items.name: Slide and Dice
items.text:
Trigger A creature is within 10 feet of a trapped wall

---
Effect The hazard makes a serrated blade Strike against all creatures within 10 feet of the west, east, or south wall; these Strikes don't take a multiple attack penalty. The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: A series of rotating, serrated blades attached to long poles routinely slice out of grooves carved into the stone walls.
